purpose: Improve RAW slanted-edge localization against pre-existing Imatest references before applying one frozen estimator to RAW and all six restoration runs.
evidence_status: retrospective_measurement_method_development; not prospective or independent efficacy confirmation

inputs.reference: pre-existing per-ROI Imatest MTF50 in the frozen cohort

partition.reason: Both partitions contain two speeds and all five distances; only the development partition may select the estimator candidate.

allowed_development.source: RAW image and Imatest reference only
allowed_development.candidate_family: Use Gaussian smoothing only for signed-gradient edge localization; retain original RAW pixel values for ESF/LSF/MTF computation. Candidate localization sigmas are evaluated in ascending order from 0.75, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0 to 2.5 pixels.
allowed_development.selection_rule: Choose the first, lowest-sigma candidate meeting every development gate. If none passes, stop and revise the contract before any holdout or restoration output is opened.
prohibited: distance-, ISO-, speed-, arm-, or seed-specific estimator parameters
using Imatest MTF50 as an inference input
assigning fallback values when an MTF50 crossing is not measured
changing the original ROI coordinates or dropping difficult ROIs

restoration_release.condition: All holdout gates pass and estimator code, parameters, tests, and input hashes are frozen before restoration inference.
restoration_release.analysis: Use an identical complete-case ROI set across RAW and six restoration runs; preserve the original 42 primary condition cells and distance-specific least-degraded operational references.
restoration_release.interpretation: A valid estimator permits re-analysis but does not guarantee MERIT improvement. Positive or negative restored-minus-RAW outcomes are reported without gate revision.

claim_limits: The v1 failure and d5580 negative result remain preserved.
The v2 analysis is retrospective measurement-method development after v1 aggregate results were known.
Passing this contract does not establish ISO 12233 compliance, cross-camera optical calibration, field lux calibration, or natural-crack optical truth.
